title: HMAC Final returns WC_HW_E not CRYPTOCB_UNAVAILABLE when INIT fails
description: Why correct: Update calls returned 0 (claiming the data). If Final fell back to software with CRYPTOCB_UNAVAILABLE, wolfSSL's software HMAC state has no data and would compute HMAC over empty input, returning a wrong MAC silently. Returning WC_HW_E surfaces a hard error instead. A future contributor might 'simplify' this to CRYPTOCB_UNAVAILABLE like the cipher/hash INIT failure path — that would introduce a MAC bypass.
